no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Lead asset AVERSA Fentanyl (abuse-deterrent fentanyl transdermal system, partnered with Kindeva Drug Delivery) is at IND-pending stage as of the FY2025 10-K. Following a 2025-09-18 FDA Type C meeting, NutriBand is preparing an IND to support a Phase 1 Human Abuse Potential study; no IND has been filed and no clinical trial has been initiated. Follow-on assets AVERSA Buprenorphine and AVERSA Methylphenidate are preclinical concepts. No active P1/P2/P3 clinical trials. Note: NTRBW is the warrant ticker; NTRB is the common-stock ticker for the same issuer.
